title: Shinobi Masters of Disguise
hook: Real ninjas rarely wore black pajamas—they dressed as monks and tea vendors.

scenes.text: In cinema, ninjas leap across rooftops wearing pitch-black hoods and masks, but in feudal Japan, that outfit would get you executed immediately.

scenes.voicedText: In cinema, ninjas leap across rooftops wearing pitch-black hoods and masks, but in feudal Japan, that outfit would get you executed immediately.

scenes.text: Historical shinobi relied on the 'Shichi-hō-de'—the Seven Disguises: wandering Buddhist priests, acrobats, farmers, and traveling merchants.

scenes.voicedText: Historical shinobi relied on the 'Shichi-hō-de'—the Seven Disguises: wandering Buddhist priests, acrobats, farmers, and traveling merchants.

scenes.text: Dressed as street performers, they slipped freely past castle checkpoints, observing palace floorplans and counting guard rotations.

scenes.text: Their weapons were ordinary farming tools: 'kunai' trowels for digging masonry, and iron sickles converted into concealed climbing claws.

scenes.text: For silent assassinations, they poisoned water wells or coated needles in aconite wolfsbane toxin that induced heart attacks without leaving wounds.
